court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Jalaun at Orai in Criminal Misc. Case No. 419 of 2021
case_name: Ankit Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others

parties.respondent_defendant: State Of U.P. And 2 Others (wife and minor son)

facts_of_case: The revisionist solemnized marriage with Opposite Party No. 2 on 08.02.2019 as per Hindu rituals. The Opposite Party No. 2 alleged that she was tortured by her husband and in-laws for demand of dowry and therefore, she and her minor son left the house of the revisionist.

legal_principles.principle: No wife shall be entitled to receive an allowance for the maintenance or interim maintenance and expenses of proceeding, as the case may be, if she is living in adultery, or if, without any sufficient reason, she refuses to live with her husband, or if they are living separately by mutual consent.
legal_principles.held: It is held that a wife shall not be entitled to receive an allowance for the maintenance or interim maintenance and expenses of proceeding, as the case may be, if she is living in adultery, or if, without any sufficient reason, she refuses to live with her husband, or if they are living separately by mutual consent.

outcome.final_order: Maintenance of Rs. 8,000/- per-month w.e.f. 06.07.2021 till 2.10.2023 and maintenance of Rs. 10,000/- per-month w.e.f. 3.10.2023 had been awarded in favour of Opposite Party No. 2.
